title: Rickroller
description: This is a lightweight rickroller that has a command, /freemoney that actually rickroles the user in the chat! Sadly no actual video or images. (yet)
body: RickRollerPlugin is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that plays a Rick Astley ASCII animation in chat when a player types the command /freemoney. It’s a harmless prank that only affects the player who triggers it—no global spam, no resource packs, and no mods required. The animation runs through iconic Rickroll lyrics with stylized ASCII art, creating a fun and unexpected moment. Built with the Spigot API and Maven, it’s easy to install: just drop the .jar into your server’s plugins folder and restart. Perfect for servers that want a little extra groove and mischief.
